package com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;

/** FIX-124: commit market input before locking a position. Execute protection
 * before publishing the closed-candle event, preserving that ordering. No outer
 * transaction may retain candle locks while a protection transaction runs.
 */
@Service
public class KlineTransactionCoordinator {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KlineTransactionCoordinator.class);
    private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2;
    private KlineTiming timing = KlineTiming.loggingOnly();
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
    public void setTiming(KlineTiming timing) { this.timing = timing; }
    private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
    private final Fix124ProtectionStore diagnostics;

    public KlineTransactionCoordinator(PlatformTransactionManager manager, Fix124ProtectionStore diagnostics) {
        transaction = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
        transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
        // FIX-153: current committed ordering after consistency locks; bound JDBC transaction work.
        transaction.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);
        transaction.setTimeout(30);
        this.diagnostics = diagnostics;
    }

    public void process(String symbol, String interval, Instant candleOpenTime, Instant observedAt,
                        BigDecimal price, Runnable persistInput, Runnable protect,
                        Runnable observe, Runnable publishClosed) {
        var context = timing.context(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt, null);
        // Candle and exact canonical price observation commit together. A failed
        // input write must not produce an unrecorded protection decision.
        try {
            timing.measure(context,"INPUT_TRANSACTION",false,()->transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->persistInput.run()));
            com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.INPUT_COMMITTED);
        }catch(RuntimeException failure){
            com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.INPUT_FAILED_OR_UNCONFIRMED);throw failure;
        }
        // FIX-131: executeWithoutResult returned successfully: this is input COMMIT, not callback completion.
        try { com.crypto.client.binance.websocket.KlineReceipt.inputCommitted(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt); }
        catch (RuntimeException diagnosticFailure) { log.warn("[FIX-131][RECEIPT_DIAGNOSTIC_FAILED] symbol={}", symbol, diagnosticFailure); }
        if (protect != null) {
            int attempts = 0;
            RuntimeException failure = null;
            do {
                attempts++;
                try {
                    timing.measure(context, "PROTECTION_TRANSACTION", false, () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> protect.run()));
                    failure = null;
                    break;
                } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                    failure = ex;
                    // FIX-153: completion returned/failed; a commit exception alone does not prove rollback.
                    // Never retry a late wallet/commit error or an unknown outcome.
                    if (!(ex instanceof InitialPositionLockDeadlock) || attempts == MAX_ATTEMPTS) break;
                    log.warn("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][INITIAL_LOCK_RETRY] symbol={}, candleOpenTime={}, observedAt={}, attempt={}",
                            symbol, candleOpenTime, observedAt, attempts);
                }
            } while (attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS);
            if (failure != null || attempts > 1) {
                String outcome = failure == null ? "RECOVERED" : "FAILED";
                if (failure == null) {
                    log.info("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][RECOVERED] symbol={}, observedAt={}, attempts={}", symbol, observedAt, attempts);
                } else {
                    com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_FAILED_OR_UNCONFIRMED);
                    log.error("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][FAILED] symbol={}, observedAt={}, attempts={}; input committed; protection completion failed or unconfirmed, consult durable price evidence",
                            symbol, observedAt, attempts, failure);
                }
                diagnostics.record(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt, price, attempts, outcome, failure);
            }
        }
        if (observe != null) {
            try {
                timing.measure(context, "OBSERVER_TRANSACTION", false, () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> observe.run()));
            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                log.warn("[FIX-124][OBSERVER_FAILED] symbol={}; input committed; protection outcome remains in durable price evidence", symbol, ex);
            }
        }
        // AFTER_COMMIT listener still receives an actual committed transaction;
        // publishing outside a transaction would silently drop the analysis event.
        if (publishClosed != null) timing.measure(context, "CLOSE_DISPATCH_TRANSACTION", false,
                () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> publishClosed.run()));
    }
}

 341:         // BEFORE risk sizing and wallet persistence. Never size from a stale signal snapshot.
 342:         ExecutionPriceAuthorityService.ExecutionPrice freshExecutionPrice = executionPriceAuthorityService
 343:                 .resolve(symbol, Instant.now()).orElse(null);
 344:         if (freshExecutionPrice == null) {
 345:             log.info("Execution Intelligence approved signal {} but no fresh canonical execution price was available; BUY skipped.",
 346:                     executionSignal.getId());
 347:             return Optional.empty();
 348:         }
 349:         executionDecision = executionIntelligenceService.revalidateAtExecutionPrice(
 350:                 executionSignal, executionDecision, freshExecutionPrice.price());
 351:         if (!executionDecision.allowed()) {
 352:             log.info("BUY revalidation rejected signal {} at fresh price {}: {} - {}",
 353:                     executionSignal.getId(), freshExecutionPrice.price(), executionDecision.code(), executionDecision.explanation());
 354:             return Optional.empty();
 355:         }
 356:         // Recompute exposure after fresh-price Entry Quality because the final guard may
 357:         // reduce the approved allocation further than the signal-time decision did.
 358:         executionPercent = executionDecision.positionPercent();
 359:         effectivePositionPercent = Math.max(1,
 360:                 Math.min(100, (int) Math.round(atrPercent * executionPercent / 100.0)));
 361:         positionScale = BigDecimal.valueOf(effectivePositionPercent)
 362:                 .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC);
 363:         riskAmount = properties.paperAccountBalance()
 364:                 .multiply(properties.riskPerTradePercent(), MC)
 365:                 .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
 366:                 .multiply(positionScale, MC);
 367:         BigDecimal riskPerUnit = freshExecutionPrice.price().subtract(executionSignal.getStopLoss(), MC).abs();
 368: 
 369:         if (riskPerUnit.signum() == 0) {
 370:             throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid stop-loss distance");
 371:         }
 372: 
 373:         BigDecimal riskModelQuantity = riskAmount.divide(riskPerUnit, MC);
 374: 
 375:         final boolean walletExecuted;
 376:         try {
 377:             ExecutionIntelligenceService.EntryQuality entryQuality =
 378:                     executionIntelligenceService.assessEntryQualityAtPrice(executionSignal, freshExecutionPrice.price());
 379:             walletExecuted = walletAutoExecutionService.executeBuy(executionSignal, freshExecutionPrice.price(), freshExecutionPrice.observedAt(), effectivePositionPercent,
 380:                     "Execution Intelligence [" + executionDecision.source() + "] " + executionDecision.explanation()
 381:                             + " DecisionPrice=" + executionSignal.getLatestPrice()
 382:                             + ", executionPrice=" + freshExecutionPrice.price()
 383:                             + ", priceObservedAt=" + freshExecutionPrice.observedAt(),
 384:                     executionDecision.source(),
 385:                     entryQuality.score());
 386:         } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
 387:             log.error("Automatic wallet BUY failed for signal {}: {}", executionSignal.getId(), ex.getMessage(), ex);
 388:             return Optional.empty();
 389:         }
 390:         if (!walletExecuted) {
 391:             log.info("Execution Intelligence approved signal {} but wallet controls declined execution; no paper position was created.", executionSignal.getId());
 392:             return Optional.empty();
 393:         }
 394: 
 395:         BigDecimal executedQuantity = walletTradeRepository
 396:                 .findTopBySignalIdAndSideAndStatusOrderByExecutedAtDesc(executionSignal.getId(), "BUY", "EXECUTED")
 397:                 .map(com.crypto.wallet.domain.WalletTrade::getQuantity)
 398:                 .filter(q -> q != null && q.signum() > 0)
 399:                 .orElse(riskModelQuantity);
 400: 
 401:         executionIntelligenceService.markExecuted(executionSignal, executionDecision);
 402:         PaperPosition position = positionRepository.save(PaperPosition.builder()
 403:                 .symbol(symbol)
 404:                 .side(PositionSide.BUY)
 405:                 .status(PositionStatus.OPEN)
 406:                 .quantity(executedQuantity)
 407:                 .entryPrice(freshExecutionPrice.price())
 408:                 .stopLoss(executionSignal.getStopLoss())
 409:                 .takeProfit(executionSignal.getTakeProfit())
 410:                 .signal(executionSignal)
 411:                 .entryReason(executionSignal.getExplanation() + " | Execution Intelligence [" + executionDecision.source() + "]: " + executionDecision.explanation() + " Effective position " + effectivePositionPercent + "%.")
 412:                 .openedAt(Instant.now())
 413:                 .build());
 414:         return Optional.of(position);
 415:     }

  74:     @Transactional
  75:     public void onPrice(String symbolValue, BigDecimal price) {
  76:         if (symbolValue == null || symbolValue.isBlank() || price == null || price.signum() <= 0) return;
  77:         String symbol = symbolValue.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  78: 
  79:         // FIX-124: classify ONLY the first lock failure. The caller may retry after
  80:         // rollback in a fresh transaction; failures after evaluation are not retried.
  81:         if(walletCoordination!=null)walletCoordination.symbol(symbol);
  82:         WalletManagedPosition managed;
  83:         try {
  84:             managed = managedPositionRepository
  85:                     .findFirstBySymbolAndStatusOrderByOpenedAtDesc(symbol, "OPEN")
  86:                     .orElse(null);
  87:         } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
  88:             if (com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction.InitialPositionLockDeadlock.isMysqlDeadlock(failure)) {
  89:                 throw new com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction.InitialPositionLockDeadlock(failure);
  90:             }
  91:             throw failure;
  92:         }
  93:         if (managed == null || managed.getQuantity() == null || managed.getQuantity().signum() <= 0) return;
  94: 
  95:         TradeSignal one = tradeSignalRepository.findTopBySymbolAndIntervalOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(symbol, "1m").orElse(null);
  96:         TradeSignal five = tradeSignalRepository.findTopBySymbolAndIntervalOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(symbol, "5m").orElse(null);
  97:         TradeSignal hour = tradeSignalRepository.findTopBySymbolAndIntervalOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(symbol, "1h").orElse(null);
  98: 
  99:         // Reaching TP is a management checkpoint, not an unconditional full exit.
 100:         if (managed.getTakeProfitUsdt() != null && price.compareTo(managed.getTakeProfitUsdt()) >= 0) {
 101:             // Pass the complete immutable BUY thesis. PositionContinuationPolicy and
 102:             // PositionManagementService now evaluate the same deterioration pressure (FIX-011).
 103:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(one, five, hour,
 104:                     managed.getEntryTrendScore(), managed.getEntryStructureScore(),
 105:                     managed.getEntryMomentumScore(), managed.getEntryVolumeScore(),
 106:                     managed.getEntryConfidence(), managed.getEntryTotalScore());
 107:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
 108:                 BigDecimal distance = managed.getTakeProfitUsdt().subtract(managed.getAverageEntryPriceUsdt());
 109:                 BigDecimal oldTarget = managed.getTakeProfitUsdt();
 110:                 BigDecimal newTarget = oldTarget.add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
 111:                 Instant changedAt = Instant.now();
 112: 
 113:                 // FIX-118 behavioral phase: if Profit Lock was already earned under the old TP
 114:                 // but the wider approved target moves current progress back below activation,
 115:                 // persist TP_EXTENSION_REBASE before saving the new geometry. The historical
 116:                 // lock remains stored but is non-executable until new-geometry activation is
 117:                 // earned again.

 119:                         dynamicProfitLockService.onTakeProfitExtended(managed, newTarget, price, changedAt);
 120:                 log.info("[FIX-118][PRODUCTION][TP_EXTENSION] positionId={}, symbol={}, marketPrice={}, entry={}, oldTp={}, newTp={}, " +
 121:                                 "highest={}, profitLockActive={}, profitLockPrice={}, previousState={}, state={}, " +
 122:                                 "newGeometryProgressPct={}, activationPct={}",

 125:                         fix118Transition.previousState(), fix118Transition.state(), fix118Transition.progressPercent(),
 126:                         fix118Transition.activationPercent());

 130:                 // arm/rejection was relative to the superseded target and must be restarted.
 131:                 resetNearTpTrackingForNewRiskGeometry(managed);

 133:                 managedPositionRepository.save(managed);
 134: 
 135:                 // FIX-067: Production has two persisted views of the same open lifecycle:
 136:                 // wallet_managed_position drives live protection, while paper_position is also
 137:                 // evaluated when a fresh TradeSignal arrives.  Before this fix only the managed
 138:                 // position received a TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED update.  The next 1m signal could
 139:                 // therefore see the stale ORIGINAL paper TP and close the wallet early.
 140:                 // PEPE wallet #833 / managed position #552 proved the race: managed TP was
 141:                 // extended 0.000004146897 -> 0.000004165346, but the signal path sold at
 142:                 // 0.000004150 because paper_position still held 0.000004146897.
 143:                 // Keep both Production state holders synchronized inside this same transaction.
 144:                 PaperPosition synchronizedPaper = paperPositionRepository

 154:                 positionManagementEventRepository.save(PositionManagementEvent.builder()

 165:             } else if (walletAutoExecutionService.executeMechanicalExit(

 211:             if (price.compareTo(hardProfitFloor) < 0) {

 251:     private void evaluateNearTpProtection(WalletManagedPosition managed, BigDecimal price,
 252:                                           TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal fiveMinute) {
 253:         // FIX-11T evidence is explicitly time-safe. Normal Production logic above keeps its
 254:         // existing signal lookup unchanged; Near-TP alone falls back to an at-or-before query
 255:         // if the repository's newest row is future-dated relative to this live evaluation.
 256:         Instant evaluatedAt = Instant.now();
 257:         oneMinute = latestEligibleSignal(managed.getSymbol(), "1m", oneMinute, evaluatedAt);
 258:         fiveMinute = latestEligibleSignal(managed.getSymbol(), "5m", fiveMinute, evaluatedAt);
 259: 
 260:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State state = new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
 261:                 managed.getNearTpState() == null ? NearTpState.INACTIVE : managed.getNearTpState(),
 262:                 managed.getNearTpBestPrice(), managed.getNearTpBearishStreak(),
 263:                 managed.getNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), managed.isNearTpHarvestUsed());
 264: 
 265:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.Evaluation evaluation = nearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
 266:                 state, managed.getAverageEntryPriceUsdt(), managed.getTakeProfitUsdt(),
 267:                 price, evaluatedAt, oneMinute, fiveMinute);
 268: 
 269:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State next = evaluation.state();
 270:         boolean stateChanged = managed.getNearTpState() != next.nearTpState()
 271:                 || !sameDecimal(managed.getNearTpBestPrice(), next.bestPrice())
 272:                 || managed.getNearTpBearishStreak() != next.consecutiveBearishOneMinute()
 273:                 || !java.util.Objects.equals(managed.getNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), next.lastEvaluatedOneMinuteSignalId());
 274:         if (stateChanged) {
 275:             managed.setNearTpState(next.nearTpState());
 276:             managed.setNearTpBestPrice(next.bestPrice());
 277:             managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(next.consecutiveBearishOneMinute());
 278:             managed.setNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(next.lastEvaluatedOneMinuteSignalId());
 279:             managed.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
 280:             managedPositionRepository.save(managed);
 281:         }
 282: 
 283:         if (evaluation.transition() || stateChanged) {
 284:             log.info("FIX-11T Near-TP evaluation: positionId={}, symbol={}, state={}, code={}, price={}, bestPrice={}, " +
 285:                             "tpProgressPct={}, givebackPct={}, bearish1mStreak={}, oneMinuteId={}, oneMinuteOriginal={}, " +
 286:                             "fiveMinuteId={}, fiveMinuteOriginal={}, detail={}",
 287:                     managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), next.nearTpState(), evaluation.code(), price, next.bestPrice(),
 288:                     evaluation.tpProgressPercent(), evaluation.givebackPercent(), next.consecutiveBearishOneMinute(),
 289:                     oneMinute == null ? null : oneMinute.getId(),
 290:                     oneMinute == null ? null : oneMinute.getOriginalDecision(),
 291:                     fiveMinute == null ? null : fiveMinute.getId(),
 292:                     fiveMinute == null ? null : fiveMinute.getOriginalDecision(),
 293:                     evaluation.explanation());
 294:         } else if (log.isDebugEnabled() && evaluation.code().startsWith("HOLD_")) {
 295:             log.debug("FIX-11T Near-TP hold: positionId={}, symbol={}, code={}, price={}, detail={}",
 296:                     managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), evaluation.code(), price, evaluation.explanation());
 297:         }
 298: 
 299:         if (!evaluation.harvestEligible()) return;
 300: 
 301:         WalletAutoExecutionService.PartialHarvestResult harvest = walletAutoExecutionService
 302:                 .executeNearTpPartialHarvest(managed.getSymbol(), price, evaluation.explanation());
 303:         if (!harvest.executed()) {
 304:             log.warn("FIX-11T Near-TP harvest not executed: positionId={}, symbol={}, status={}, price={}",
 305:                     managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), harvest.status(), price);
 306:             // If execution did not happen, return to rejection monitoring rather than leaving
 307:             // the state stranded in FAILURE_CONFIRMED. Idempotency still lives in wallet_trade.
 308:             managed.setNearTpState(NearTpState.NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED);
 309:             if ("BELOW_BINANCE_MINIMUM".equals(harvest.status())
 310:                     || "BINANCE_MINIMUM_UNAVAILABLE".equals(harvest.status())) {
 311:                 // The skipped order consumed the current confirmation pair. Requiring fresh
 312:                 // bearish evidence prevents a retry on every subsequent market-price tick.
 313:                 managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(0);
 314:             }
 315:             managed.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
 316:             managedPositionRepository.save(managed);
 317:             return;
 318:         }
 319: 
 320:         // Keep paper_position quantity/P&L synchronized with the managed wallet lifecycle.
 321:         // Without this, a later terminal signal close would calculate P&L on pre-harvest quantity.
 322:         PaperPosition paper = paperPositionRepository.findBySymbolAndStatus(managed.getSymbol(), PositionStatus.OPEN).orElse(null);
 323:         if (paper != null) {
 324:             paper.setQuantity(harvest.remainingQuantity());
 325:             BigDecimal priorRealized = paper.getRealizedPnl() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : paper.getRealizedPnl();
 326:             paper.setRealizedPnl(priorRealized.add(harvest.realizedPnlUsdt(), MC));
 327:             paperPositionRepository.save(paper);
 328:         }
 329: 
 330:         log.info("FIX-11T NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED: positionId={}, symbol={}, soldQty={}, remainingQty={}, " +
 331:                         "price={}, realizedPnl={}, realizedPnlPct={}",
 332:                 managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), harvest.soldQuantity(), harvest.remainingQuantity(),
 333:                 price, harvest.realizedPnlUsdt(), harvest.realizedPnlPercent());
 334:     }

 336:     private TradeSignal latestEligibleSignal(String symbol, String interval, TradeSignal newest, Instant evaluatedAt) {
 337:         if (newest != null && newest.getGeneratedAt() != null && !newest.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(evaluatedAt)) {
 338:             return newest;
 339:         }
 340:         return tradeSignalRepository
 341:                 .findTopBySymbolAndIntervalAndGeneratedAtLessThanEqualOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(symbol, interval, evaluatedAt)
 342:                 .orElse(null);
 343:     }
 344: 
 345:     /**
 346:      * FIX-117: TP extension must not erase Near-TP protection that was already earned.
 347:      *
 348:      * Only ARMED and REJECTION_DETECTED change from the pre-FIX-117 behavior. INACTIVE
 349:      * still resets against the new geometry. FAILURE_CONFIRMED also keeps the existing
 350:      * reset behavior because that persisted/transient lifecycle has a real interruption
 351:      * window between state save and harvest resolution and is intentionally out of scope.
 352:      * PARTIAL_HARVESTED remains terminal through the existing harvest-used guard.

 503:         position.setStatus(status);
 504:         position.setCloseReason(closeReason);
 505:         position.setExitReason(explanation);
 506:         position.setExitSignal(exitSignal);
 507:         position.setClosedAt(Instant.now());

package com.crypto.execution.processing;

import com.crypto.domain.PaperPosition;
import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import com.crypto.repository.TradeSignalRepository;
import com.crypto.wallet.repository.WalletManagedPositionRepository;
import com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction.InitialPositionLockDeadlock;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Function;

/** FIX-127: one coordinator for all Production signal callers. No retry of the
 * existing body after it has begun; only the new initial lock is retry-marked. */
@Service
public class SignalProcessingCoordinator {
    // FIX-125 mandatory in Spring; null only in existing constructor-only policy tests.
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
    private com.crypto.wallet.service.WalletTransactionCoordination walletCoordination;

    private static final Logger log=LoggerFactory.getLogger(SignalProcessingCoordinator.class);
    private final SignalProcessingStore store;
    private final TradeSignalRepository signals;
    private final WalletManagedPositionRepository positions;
    private final SignalProcessingFreshness freshness;
    private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
    public SignalProcessingCoordinator(SignalProcessingStore store, TradeSignalRepository signals,
            WalletManagedPositionRepository positions, SignalProcessingFreshness freshness, PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
        this.store=store;this.signals=signals;this.positions=positions;this.freshness=freshness;
        transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);
        transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
    }
    public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
            Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business) {
        return process(signalId,background,business,null);
    }
    public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
            Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business, Long sourceEventId) {
        if(TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive())
            throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 caller must be outside the processing transaction");
        if(!background && !store.exists(signalId)) {
            // Automatic callers have already registered atomically with creation.
            // Explicit existing-signal calls register only at the user's request.
            transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->store.register(signals.findById(signalId)
                    .orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal not found: "+signalId)),ProcessingOrigin.EXPLICIT));
        }
        store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
        for(int localAttempt=0;localAttempt<2;localAttempt++) {
            var work=store.claim(signalId,background);
            if(work==null) {
                log.info("[FIX-127][NOT_CLAIMED] signalId={}, background={}; no processing performed",signalId,background);
                return Optional.empty();
            }
            log.info("[FIX-127][ATTEMPT] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candleOpenTime={}, origin={}, attempt={}, background={}",
                    signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.candleOpenTime(),work.origin(),work.attempts(),background);
            java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger completion=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger(-1);
            try {
                Optional<PaperPosition> result=transaction.execute(tx->{
                    org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(
                        new org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization() {
                            @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) { completion.set(status); }
                        });
                    // FIX-140: observe the real transaction completion; a thrown exception alone
                    // does not prove rollback. The private marker is only created here.
                    if(walletCoordination!=null) {
                        try { walletCoordination.symbol(work.symbol()); }
                        catch(RuntimeException failure) {
                            if(sourceEventId!=null && retryableSymbolLock(failure))throw new SymbolLockFailure(failure);
                            throw failure;
                        }
                    }
                    var owned=store.locked(signalId);
                    if(owned==null || !"RUNNING".equals(owned.status()) || !work.owner().equals(owned.owner()))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 processing ownership changed");
                    // Acquire before PositionManagementService inserts a referencing
                    // advisory or executes POSITION_STOP_LOSS. No rules evaluated yet.
                    try {
                        positions.findFirstBySymbolAndStatusOrderByOpenedAtDesc(work.symbol(),"OPEN");
                    } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
                        if(InitialPositionLockDeadlock.isMysqlDeadlock(ex))throw new InitialLockFailure(ex);
                        throw ex;
                    }
                    store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
                    // Read signal/freshness after lock acquisition: lock wait must not
                    // consume the recovery grace before it is checked, or establish an
                    // ordinary repeatable-read snapshot before the position is locked.
                    TradeSignal signal=signals.findById(signalId).orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal missing"));
                    if(!work.symbol().equals(signal.getSymbol()) || !work.interval().equals(signal.getInterval())
                            || !work.candleOpenTime().equals(signal.getCandleOpenTime()))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 signal lineage changed");
                    // FIX-153: every claimed attempt, including the first direct
                    // attempt regardless of origin, is checked after normal locks.
                    if(!freshness.eligible(work))throw new Expired();
                    Optional<PaperPosition> outcome=business.apply(signal);
                    store.complete(work,outcome.map(PaperPosition::getId).orElse(null));
                    return outcome;
                });
                log.info("[FIX-127][COMPLETED] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}; processing committed (not necessarily a trade)",
                        signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts());
                return result;
            } catch(Expired ex) {
                // Only exact RUNNING ownership can expire this attempt, after business TX rolled back.
                if(store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,"EXPIRED","FRESHNESS","Exact candle is no longer latest and fresh")!=1)
                    throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 expiry ownership unconfirmed: signal="+signalId);
                log.warn("[FIX-127][EXPIRED] signalId={}, symbol={}, attempt={}",signalId,work.symbol(),work.attempts());
                return Optional.empty();
            } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
                // FIX-140: only this invocation's initial symbol-lock marker plus a
                // confirmed rollback grants retry. Unknown connection/commit failures stay review-only.
                if(ex instanceof SymbolLockFailure && completion.get()==
                        org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_ROLLED_BACK) {
                    String result=work.attempts()<4?"SYMBOL_LOCK_RETRY":"LOCK_RETRY_EXHAUSTED";
                    int changed=store.finishSymbolLockFailure(work,result,ex.toString());
                    if(changed!=1)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-140 retry persistence unconfirmed",ex);
                    log.warn("[FIX-140][SAFE_RETRY_RESULT] event={}, signal={}, attempt={}, outcome={}, rollback=CONFIRMED",
                        sourceEventId,signalId,work.attempts(),result);
                    if("SYMBOL_LOCK_RETRY".equals(result))throw new SymbolLockRetryScheduled(signalId);
                    return Optional.empty();
                }
                boolean initial=ex instanceof InitialLockFailure;
                String status=initial && work.attempts()<2 ? "RETRYABLE_FAILURE" : "REVIEW_REQUIRED";
                int recorded=store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,status,initial ? "INITIAL_POSITION_LOCK" : "PROCESSING_OR_COMMIT",ex.toString());
                log.error("[FIX-127][{}] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}, initialLock={}",
                        recorded==1 ? status : "FAILURE_RECORD_NOT_UPDATED",signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts(),initial,ex);
                if(!initial || work.attempts()>=2)throw ex;
                // TransactionTemplate completed rollback before entering this catch.
            }
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }
    // FIX-140: classify only known lock cancellation/deadlock errors. Communications
    // errors are deliberately excluded even when nested below a data-access exception.
    static boolean retryableSymbolLock(Throwable failure) {
        for(Throwable e=failure;e!=null;e=e.getCause())
            if(e instanceof java.sql.SQLException sql && sql.getSQLState()!=null && sql.getSQLState().startsWith("08"))return false;
        for(Throwable e=failure;e!=null;e=e.getCause())
            if(e instanceof org.springframework.dao.QueryTimeoutException ||
               e instanceof java.sql.SQLTimeoutException ||
               e instanceof java.sql.SQLException sql && (sql.getErrorCode()==1205 || sql.getErrorCode()==1213))return true;
        return false;
    }
    private static final class SymbolLockFailure extends RuntimeException {
        SymbolLockFailure(Throwable cause) { super(cause); }
    }
    // A private marker cannot be supplied by a later business callback.
    private static final class InitialLockFailure extends RuntimeException {
        InitialLockFailure(RuntimeException cause) { super(cause); }
    }
    private static final class Expired extends RuntimeException {}
}

package com.crypto.execution.service;

import com.crypto.market.service.MarketPriceEventService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * FIX-056 fresh execution-price authority.
 *
 * <p>TradeSignal.latestPrice is immutable decision-time evidence and must never be
 * treated as an execution fill. Production resolves the newest canonical Binance 1m
 * live-price event recorded by FIX-052. Administration Replay resolves the newest
 * replay price event already consumed by ExecutionReplayScope. This gives both paths
 * one price authority while preserving the original signal snapshot for audit.</p>
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExecutionPriceAuthorityService {
    private static final Duration MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE = Duration.ofSeconds(15);

    private final MarketPriceEventService marketPriceEventService;
    private final ExecutionReplayScope replayScope;

    public Optional<ExecutionPrice> resolve(String symbol, Instant referenceTime) {
        // FIX-109 / Replay parity: wall-clock fallback is forbidden. Every caller must
        // supply the evaluation clock explicitly so historical Replay can never silently
        // compare an old market event with the machine clock used by Production today.
        Instant reference = Objects.requireNonNull(referenceTime,
                "Execution price reference time is required");

        if (replayScope.active()) {
            return replayScope.latestPrice()
                    .filter(p -> symbol != null && symbol.equalsIgnoreCase(p.symbol()))
                    .filter(p -> !p.observedAt().isAfter(reference))
                    .filter(p -> !Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).isNegative())
                    .filter(p -> Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).compareTo(MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE) <= 0)
                    .map(p -> new ExecutionPrice(p.price(), p.observedAt(), "REPLAY_MARKET_PRICE_EVENT"));
        }

        return marketPriceEventService.findLatestAtOrBefore(symbol, reference)
                .filter(p -> Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).compareTo(MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE) <= 0)
                .map(p -> new ExecutionPrice(p.price(), p.observedAt(), p.source()));
    }

    public record ExecutionPrice(BigDecimal price, Instant observedAt, String source) {}
}

## FINDINGS

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Frozen population remains exactly `paper_position` IDs **182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137**. The permitted `db/CODEX` directory has no result artifacts; no trade-specific DB fact is available.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Current entry route is:

  `trade_signal` → `signal_processing_work` claim/freshness check → execution validation → canonical fresh price (≤15 seconds) → wallet BUY → `paper_position` OPEN.

  A completed processing-work record does not prove entry; the durable `paper_position` and corresponding executed wallet BUY are required. [SignalProcessingCoordinator.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/processing/SignalProcessingCoordinator.java:48), [PaperTradingService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:340), [ExecutionPriceAuthorityService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/service/ExecutionPriceAuthorityService.java:30).

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** For a new BUY, wallet execution occurs before the `paper_position` is created. The position uses the canonical execution price but timestamps itself with a separate `Instant.now()`. Therefore, entry timing must be reconciled against `wallet_trade.executed_at`; `paper_position.opened_at` alone is not necessarily the exact wallet execution instant. [PaperTradingService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:375).

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Current mechanical-exit priority is: take-profit checkpoint/extension, stop loss, profit-lock hard floor, profit-lock policy exit, normal signal-driven exit, then near-TP partial harvest. A loss therefore requires particular scrutiny of stop-loss evidence and any earlier price events; candle OHLC is not a substitute for accepted live price evidence. [LivePositionProtectionService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:99).

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** In the direct-price route, a canonical price event is first persisted as `PENDING`; protection then atomically records `APPLIED` or `NON_CANONICAL`. `APPLIED` proves completion of the protection callback, but may still be a no-op when no open position exists. `PENDING` is unresolved, and `PROTECTION_NOT_APPLIED` is not exit evidence. [MarketPriceEventService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/market/service/MarketPriceEventService.java:45), [LivePositionProtectionService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:53).

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The two closing routes have materially different evidence ordering:
  - Signal-route `completeClose` persists `paper_position` first, then attempts a wallet exit and catches wallet exceptions.
  - Live protection executes the mechanical wallet exit first, then closes `paper_position`.
  
  Thus a paper/wallet mismatch cannot be interpreted without checking both tables and the exit audit. [PaperTradingService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:487), [LivePositionProtectionService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:165).

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** A current-code audit limitation: `LivePositionProtectionService.closePaper` records `close_reason` and immutable `production_exit_audit`, but does not populate `paper_position.exit_signal_id`. Consequently, a null exit signal cannot prove that a live mechanical close had no signal context. [LivePositionProtectionService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:391).

- **AGENT INFERENCE:** None of the above establishes which route closed any frozen trade. The running/deployed code and configuration at each historical entry/exit are also unproven.

## EVIDENCE

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** `paper_position` records entry and exit links, prices, lifecycle times, close reason, and P&L. [PaperPosition.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/domain/PaperPosition.java:10)
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** `production_exit_audit` is intended as immutable terminal-route evidence keyed to `paper_position_id`.
- **EXTERNAL RESEARCH:** None.
